title: Delete over a marquee says why it did nothing
goal: With a shape or a piece of text picked and a marquee drawn, pressing delete does nothing at all and says nothing about why. The app should tell you, in a word or two, that a marquee can only be cleared out of a picture, so you are not left pressing a key that quietly fails.
notes: Found while auditing a-marquee-keeps-the-layer-you-picked-and-delete on 2026-09-07. Walk /tmp/region-cases-walk.json stage 2-delete-on-shape: a rectangle picked, region 250,300 200x120, delete pressed, render byte-identical to the start. Before that task landed it silently painted the locked Background instead, which was worse. RegionTarget.id returns nil for a picked layer that fails RegionTarget.canSlice (Sources/PhotonzCore/RegionTarget.swift), and EditorState.deleteRegion returns early on nil. The message could hang off the same channel the measure hint uses, or the copy confirmation toast.
acceptance: With a rectangle picked and a marquee up, delete puts up a short plain message rather than doing nothing in silence
The message names what would have to be true for it to work, in ordinary words
Delete over a marquee on a picture is unchanged: it clears the pixels with no message at all
A playtest walk covers both, with the message read out of the log
